conviction_note: Half the baseline's 7.12% median, signed negative: the corpus is thin (20 filing rows, one social document, zero news items and no sell-side estimate at all), so I will not claim a big number, but the two facts I can compute from company releases both point down - the company's own guided growth in its flagship segment decelerates from +171-181% to +113-120% year over year, and the stock has taken a 30% re-rating in four weeks with no disclosure of any kind behind it since 2026-08-04.

findings.finding: So-Young's own guidance shows the flagship aesthetic treatment services segment decelerating hard: with Q4 2025 results on 2026-03-25 it guided Q1 2026 to RMB268-278m, +171.2% to +181.3% year on year; with Q1 2026 results on 2026-05-22 it guided Q2 2026 to RMB307-317m, +112.6% to +119.5% - a fifty-to-sixty point drop in the guided growth rate of the only line carrying the equity story, while consolidated revenue growth was +45.6% and the GAAP loss per share widened to -$0.48 from -$0.32 with a $7.1m quarterly net loss.
findings.why_not_priced: Both guidance ranges are triple-digit growth numbers and read as spectacular in isolation; the deceleration only appears when the two releases are put side by side, which requires the prior quarter's guide, and there is no analyst, no consensus estimate (event.json: n_estimates 'N/A', consensus_eps_forecast null) and not one news item in the whole 42-item capture to do that arithmetic for the market. The comparison also frames Q3: the base effect that produced +170% is gone. If this were priced, a name whose loss per share is widening would not be up 30% in twenty sessions.
findings.independence: Same-direction from the tape rather than the text: the market's revealed reaction function on this name already punishes growth bought with losses - the 2026-05-22 print, which carried +45.6% revenue growth and this same Q2 guide, produced a -16.48% reaction per the baseline's history block, and 5 of the 8 recorded reactions are negative including -22.73% on 2025-08-15.

findings.finding: The +30.4% twenty-day advance to $2.40 has no disclosure behind it: the last SEC filing of any kind is a 6-K accepted 2026-08-04T21:15:17Z, after which the shares ran from $1.99 to $2.4250 on ordinary volume (172k twenty-day average, only two sessions above 300k), and the capture's four sweeps returned zero news items, zero analyst notes and a social feed whose only 2026 August entries are two one-line earnings-calendar posts.
findings.corpus_ref: filings.json accession 0001104659-26-090491 (last filing before the print); quote.json bars 2026-07-31 through 2026-08-28; snapshots/20260830T083555Z.json (21 items, 20 of them filing rows) and the two 15:0x sweeps of 2026-08-30 which returned n_items 0
findings.why_not_priced: This is the inverse of a priced move - the price has moved and the information has not arrived. A $233m ADR with no coverage, no consensus and a 172k-share daily book re-rated 30% into a print on nothing that the capture can see, which means the print itself has to supply the justification. Note honestly what I cannot do: the 2026-08-04 6-K body is not stored, that filing is tagged by the baseline as producing a +5.03% move, and it may well contain the reason for the whole advance - in which case this finding shrinks to the observation that the run is resting on one unread document.
findings.independence: WARNING - clusters with finding 1 through the same social document, which is the only substantive body in the capture; treat as one source cluster and count the larger residual. Independent corroboration of the disclosure vacuum comes from a different file: filings.json shows no filing at all between 2026-08-04 and the 2026-08-30 index sweep.

baseline_tension: Cuts against the run-up: the baseline shows +30.4% over 20 days and +4.8% over 5 into the print, while the guided growth rate of the segment the story rests on is halving and the same baseline's reaction history is 5-of-8 negative with a -16.48% response to the last print.
corpus_limits: Thin capture and I have sized for it: 20 of 21 unique items are EDGAR index rows with no stored bodies, so every company number above reaches me second-hand through a single stocktwits aggregate rather than from the release itself, and the crucial 2026-08-04 6-K is unread. No option chain, so no read on which way the market leaned. No sell-side consensus exists to measure the bar against. Clean of look-ahead: all four sweeps are dated 2026-08-30 and quote.json was fetched 2026-08-30T15:07:12Z, ending at the 2026-08-28 close, so nothing here postdates the 2026-08-31T11:27Z release.
